services.name: Farm & City Centre — Masvingo
services.notes: Main agro retail for Masvingo province. Stocks drought-tolerant maize (SC403, short-season), sorghum, cotton, and sunflower inputs. Good irrigation equipment range for smallholder vegetable production along Runde River.

services.name: Windmill — Masvingo Branch
services.notes: Windmill Masvingo trade and retail. Strong livestock input range — cattle dips, vaccines, dewormers. Delivers to Gutu, Zaka, and Chivi on scheduled runs. Bulk fertiliser for communal cooperatives.

services.name: ZFC — Masvingo Depot
services.notes: ZFC fertiliser depot for Masvingo province. Compound S and D for dryland crops. Bulk orders for cooperatives. Important note: in drought years (Region 3–5), many farmers cannot afford fertiliser — ZFC cooperates with government input schemes.

services.name: Chiredzi Agro Supplies
services.notes: Chiredzi is Zimbabwe's sugar cane country. Stocks sugar cane inputs (Compound L, urea, herbicides). Also dryland crops for communal areas — drought-tolerant sorghum, millet, and cotton. Irrigation supplies for Hippo Valley outgrowers.

services.name: Gutu Agro Dealer
services.notes: Main input dealer for Gutu district. Cotton and sunflower dominant alongside maize. Quton cotton seed available through Cottco contract. Limited stock — order early before November. Gutu is one of Masvingo's more productive districts.

services.name: Seed Co — Masvingo Distribution
services.notes: Seed Co regional depot for Masvingo. SC403 (90-day drought-tolerant maize) is the primary maize variety for this region. Also SDMV millet, SC sorghum varieties, and sunflower. Critically important: ask specifically for short-season and drought-tolerant varieties for Region 3–5.

services.name: GMB — Masvingo Silo
services.notes: Main silo for Masvingo province. Maize, sorghum, groundnuts, and millet accepted. In drought years volumes are very low — GMB also coordinates emergency food distribution from this facility. Register seller number before harvest season.

services.name: GMB — Chiredzi Collection Point
services.notes: Chiredzi GMB. Accepts sorghum and millet from communal areas. Maize from irrigated plots around Hippo Valley. Sugar cane sold exclusively through sugar millers — not GMB.

services.name: GMB — Gutu Collection Point
services.notes: Seasonal GMB collection for Gutu district. Accepts maize and groundnuts. Cotton is sold to Cottco — not GMB. Gutu has better rainfall than other Masvingo districts — higher volumes in good years.

services.name: Masvingo Fresh Produce and Grain Market
services.notes: Main market for Masvingo city. Mixed grain and fresh produce. Sorghum grain, covo, tomatoes, and tropical fruit all sold here. Tourism from Great Zimbabwe National Monument creates some demand for fresh produce at hotels.

services.name: Chiredzi Fresh Market — Lowveld
services.notes: Lowveld market for Chiredzi. Hot climate — tropical produce dominates. Papaya, mango, okra, and leafy greens from sugar estate worker plots. Sorghum and millet from communal areas. High purchasing power from sugar estate workers.

services.name: Masvingo Livestock Auction — Showgrounds
services.open_hours: Monthly auction — second Tuesday of month
services.notes: Major cattle auction for Masvingo province. Cattle from Mwenezi, Chivi, and Zaka ranches. Strong beef trade — Masvingo cattle are known quality. Annual agricultural show at these grounds. Bring veterinary movement permits.

services.name: Hippo Valley Estates — Outgrower Office
services.notes: Hippo Valley is one of Africa's largest sugar estates. The outgrower scheme allows smallholder farmers to grow sugar cane under contract on allocated irrigated plots. Provides: certified cane cuttings, fertiliser on credit, irrigation water allocation, mechanical harvesting, and guaranteed buying through the mill. Very long commitment — cane ratoons for 7–10 years. Contact outgrower office well in advance as plot allocation is limited.

services.name: Triangle Sugar Estates — Outgrower Office
services.notes: Triangle is Zimbabwe's other major sugar estate alongside Hippo Valley. Both estates form the Save Valley sugar complex. Same outgrower model — allocated irrigated plots, sugar cane contract, mill processing. Triangle mill also produces ethanol. Registration waiting list — apply early.

services.name: Cottco — Gutu and Zaka Cotton Buying
services.notes: Cotton buying for Gutu and Zaka districts. Bt cotton seed on credit pre-season. Grade S1 required. Masvingo cotton tends to have shorter staple due to water stress — irrigate at critical stages for better grade. Weighbridge on site. Payment within 30 days.

services.name: AGRITEX Provincial Office — Masvingo
services.notes: Provincial AGRITEX HQ for Masvingo. Coordinates 7 district offices. Key for drought-resilient crop programmes, Conservation Agriculture (CA) promotion, and emergency input scheme coordination. Masvingo is frequently drought-affected — early season advice is especially critical.

services.name: AGRITEX District Office — Bikita (Nyika)
services.address: District Agricultural Office, Nyika Growth Point, Bikita
services.notes: Bikita is a lithium mining area with difficult farming conditions. Ward officers focus on drought-resilient crops — sorghum, cowpeas, nyimo beans. Cotton is also grown on better soils. Food security is a priority — contact for emergency input schemes.

services.name: AGRITEX District Office — Chiredzi
services.notes: Key office for Lowveld agricultural advisory. Sugar cane establishment and outgrower support. Dryland sorghum and millet for communal areas beyond the irrigation scheme. Moringa promotion for nutrition — growing interest given very dry conditions in Mwenezi border area.

services.name: AGRITEX District Office — Chivi (Ngundu)
services.address: District Agricultural Office, Ngundu Halt, Chivi
services.notes: Chivi is a chronically drought-affected district on the Harare–Beitbridge corridor. Ward officers prioritise drought-resilient crops. Ngundu Halt is an important transit point. Conservation Agriculture actively promoted here.

services.name: AGRITEX District Office — Gutu
services.address: District Agricultural Office, Gutu Growth Point
services.notes: Gutu has better rainfall than most of Masvingo — good for cotton and sunflower alongside maize. Ward officers advise on cotton agronomy and sunflower — both important cash crops for this district.

services.name: AGRITEX District Office — Mwenezi (Rutenga)
services.notes: Mwenezi is Zimbabwe's driest farming district — Region 5 bordering Gonarezhou. Cattle and small stock are the primary income. Ward officers focus almost entirely on drought-resilient crops and livestock health. Sorghum, millet, and moringa are the realistic crop options. Jatropha being piloted for degraded land rehabilitation. Government food assistance is critical here in most years.

services.name: AGRITEX District Office — Zaka
services.address: District Agricultural Office, Zaka Growth Point
services.notes: Zaka is a cotton-dominant district with maize and groundnuts. Ward officers advise on cotton agronomy and Cottco contract registration. Some tobacco is also grown in the northern parts of the district.

services.name: Lowveld Research Station — Chiredzi
services.notes: National research station for dryland and irrigation crop systems in the Lowveld. Sugar cane agronomy, drought-tolerant sorghum varieties, and cotton pest management research. Annual field day. Key resource for Chiredzi and Mwenezi communal farmers.

services.name: Agribank Zimbabwe — Masvingo Branch
services.notes: Agribank for Masvingo province. Crop loans for cotton, maize, sorghum. Sugar cane establishment loans available through the Lowveld outgrower schemes. Livestock loans for cattle ranchers in Mwenezi and Chivi. In drought years, loan repayment schedules are often restructured — discuss this upfront.
